soldier: Head orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.61–0.66, the sides nearly parallel, widest at the middle, the posterior margin together with the posterolateral corners broadly rounded. The middle of the dorsal margin of the head is arched to varying degrees, the frontal region flat and lower than the dorsal summit, the frontal slope about sixty degrees, the interfrontal area slightly forked and concave. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent region at the apex a small triangle, the apex a short needle-like point, the apical hairs present, the subapical hairs well developed, the dorsal labral hairs all rather long, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles are rather straight, their apices rather pointed and nearly straight; the mandibles 0.55–0.62 times the head capsule length and 0.84–0.99 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior quarter, the anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the waist region narrow and long with the sides slightly arcuate, the waist constriction index 0.33–0.37. The pronotum is about 1.7 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior margin fork-shaped concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with more than ten hairs in the middle region.
